title: Circle meeting the x-axis

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2021). Official MS: M1 substituting y=0, A1 x-coordinates -7 and 11. Part (b) (intersection of the tangents at A and B) is omitted: it is mainly tangent-equation work rather than the line-circle substitution of this subsection. The two x-coordinates are paper/self-mark as a pair (the checker has no list-of-roots acceptance mode).

stem:
This question is 9709/11/M/J/21 Question 10(a), taken from the official QP.

The equation of a circle is \(x^2+y^2-4x+6y-77=0\).

(a) Find the \(x\)-coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) where the circle intersects the \(x\)-axis.

steps.name: M
steps.note: MS: M1 substituting y=0 (the displayed quadratic or (x-2)^2=81 is also accepted in the scheme).

steps.name: A
steps.note: MS: A1, so x-coordinates are -7 and 11. Official answer (a): -7 and 11.
